author: Ari Koslow
title: Ty Adcock sent outright by Padres
desc: The Padres sent RHP Ty Adcock outright to Triple-A El Paso.
impact: Adcock passed through waivers unclaimed. He will remain in the Padres organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Erik Sabrowski (elbow) throws 20 pitches in rehab appearance Wednesday
desc: Erik Sabrowski threw 20 pitches in a rehab appearance on Wednesday for Double-A Akron.
impact: Sabrowski struck out two and recorded two outs. He is continuing to work his way back from elbow inflammation.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cole Ragans (elbow) transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Royals transferred LHP Cole Ragans to the 60-day injured list.
impact: Ragans continues to seek a second opinion. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Clarke Schmidt (elbow) throws bullpen Wednesday
desc: Clarke Schmidt threw a bullpen session on Wednesday at Yankee Stadium.
impact: Schmidt continues his throwing progression on his way back from last year's Tommy John surgery. He is on track to return at some point in the second half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Doug Nikhazy sent outright by Cubs
desc: The Cubs sent LHP Doug Nikhazy outright to Triple-A Iowa.
impact: Nikhazy went unclaimed on waivers after being designated for assignment earlier this week. He will remain in the Cubs organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Sproat suffers hamstring cramp Wednesday
desc: Brandon Sproat was removed from Wednesday's start against the Guardians with a right hamstring cramp.
impact: Sproat was removed almost immediately after he allowed a grand slam to Daniel Schneemann in the fourth inning. He'll figure to be further evaluated into Thursday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sean Newcomb suffers triceps injury Wednesday
desc: Sean Newcomb was removed from Wednesday's game against the Yankees with a left triceps contusion.
impact: Newcomb will head to be further evaluated. He is day-to-day heading into Thursday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Konnor Griffin (forearm) progresses to flat-ground throwing
desc: Konnor Griffin said he's progressed to flat-ground throwing from a distance of 150 feet.
impact: Griffin has been on the injured list since back in late May after being diagnosed with a low-grade flexor muscle strain in his right forearm. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jesus Made suffers quad injury in Double-A
desc: Brewers SS prospect Jesús Made was removed from Wednesday's game at Double-A Biloxi with a left quad contusion.
impact: The top prospect in baseball avoided a serious injury. Made is slashing .276/.349/.427 with six homers and 21 steals through 59 games this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Lombard diagnosed with two sprained fingers
desc: Yankees SS prospect George Lombard Jr. has been diagnosed with two sprained fingers on his throwing hand.
impact: Lombard was thought to have been dealing with a wrist sprain prior to undergoing imaging. He isn't expected to miss an extended period of time.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jung Hoo Lee goes deep in win over Braves
desc: Jung Hoo Lee went 1-for-3 in a win over the Braves with a home run, one run scored, and two RBI.
impact: Lee continues a torrid stretch at the plate, collecting hits in 20 of his last 22 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more dynamic options in the Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, carrying an .818 OPS with four home runs, 26 RBI, 36 runs scored, and three stolen bases through 65 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Casey Schmitt swipes base in win over Braves
desc: Casey Schmitt went 2-for-4 in a win over the Braves with one run scored and one stolen base.
impact: Schmitt continues a solid stretch at the plate, recording hits in eight of his last 14 games. The veteran offers manager Tony Vitello one of the more explosive options in the Giants lineup, hitting .280 with 15 homeruns, 38 RBI, 33 runs scored, and seven stolen bases through 65 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Willy Adames homers in win over Braves
desc: Willy Adames went 1-for-4 in a win over the Braves with a solo home run.
impact: Adames continues an underwhelming stretch at the plate, collecting hits in just two of his last eight contests. The shortstop remains one of many inconsistent options in the Giants lineup, hitting .229 with 12 home runs, 35 runs scored, 30 RBI, and one stolen base through 71 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Rafael Devers goes yard in win over Braves
desc: Rafael Devers went 1-for-4 in a win over the Braves with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Devers has heated back up at the plate, picking up hits in four of his last five contests. The first baseman remains one of many streaky options in the Giants lineup, batting .235 with 10 home runs, 34 runs scored, and 34 RBI through 73 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Luis Arraez picks up three hits in win over Braves
desc: Luis Arraez went 3-for-5 in a win over the Braves with one double and two runs scored.
impact: Arraez continues a dynamic stretch at the plate, registering hits in 14 of his last 15 contests. The veteran remains one of the few stable options in a streaky Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, slashing .324 with two home runs, 26 RBI, 37 runs scored, and five stolen bases through 70 games.
